Partey is due to stand trial next year in the UK on seven charges of rape and one count of sexual assault. The charges relate to allegations by four different women between 2020 and 2022. **Ghana** will be facing **Croatia**, **England**, and **Panama** in Group L.

recent_articles.title: Wave of child abuse scandals shakes schools in Paris
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A school assistant in Paris is facing trial for sexual mistreatment of young children, marking the latest case in a year-long scandal that has shaken the city's school system. **City Hall**, which employs the animateurs – non-teaching staff who care for children after school – faces criticism for its initial handling of complaints and inadequate recruitment practices.  The scandal has led to widespread distrust among parents, with many accusing **City Hall** of failing to take their concerns seriously. The mayor, **Emmanuel Grégoire**, has pledged reforms including increased training and monitoring, as well as automatic suspension of animateurs after a single complaint.

recent_articles.title: Canada’s Mark Carney calls treatment of Gaza flotilla activists ‘appalling’ | Gaza News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney** expressed outrage over the treatment of participants in a humanitarian aid flotilla bound for Gaza, calling it "appalling" and demanding an independent investigation.  Carney also reaffirmed Canada's opposition to Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank and violence by Jewish settlers against Palestinians. **Israeli President Isaac Herzog** and **Canadian Minister of Foreign Affairs Anita Anand** engaged in phone calls regarding the incident, with **Anand** promising to provide evidence of mistreatment to Israel. The flotilla was met with global condemnation, prompting several countries to issue sanctions against Israeli officials involved.

recent_articles.title: Two men arrested in connection to Dezi Freeman’s movements after Porepunkah shootings | Victoria | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Police** have arrested two men in connection with the months-long manhunt for Dezi Freeman, who killed two police officers in August. The arrests are part of **Operation Summit**, which investigates Freeman's movements after the shootings at Porepunkah.  The investigation is ongoing and no further details were provided by **police**.

recent_articles.title: Father sentenced to 20 years in prison in POCSO case in Ranga Reddy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **37-year-old laborer** from Kurvaguda village in Shabad mandal was sentenced to 20 years of rigorous imprisonment and a ₹7 lakh compensation for sexually assaulting his daughter. The **Shabad police** registered a POCSO case based on the victim's complaint filed on October 12, 2024.  The court found him guilty under provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

recent_articles.title: Texas officers rescue infant from car trapped in floodwaters | Texas | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Beeville police** and firefighters rescued an infant from a submerged vehicle in Beeville, Texas on Saturday after heavy rainfall overwhelmed a low-water crossing. The driver had been attempting to cross the flooded area when he was stopped by **fire chief** who attempted to warn him of the danger.  The incident highlights the dangers of flood waters and urges drivers to avoid flooded roads and heed barricades placed for safety reasons.

recent_articles.title: Thoothukudi schoolgirl sexual assault and murder case: Man gets death penalty on two counts - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dharma Muneeswaran**, 38, of Sayalkudi, was sentenced to death by a special court in Thoothukudi for the sexual assault and murder of a 17-year-old schoolgirl. The girl went missing on March 10th and her body was found murdered on March 11th near her residence.  The Kulathur police conducted an investigation and sent the body to the Thoothukudi Government Medical College and Hospital for post-mortem examination.

recent_articles.title: Megyn Kelly says 'Trump cheated on every wife he's had', Internet wonders what happened to her - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Megyn Kelly** made controversial claims that **President Donald Trump** cheated on all his wives, sparking online debate. recent_articles.title: ‘Rape, murder’ of minor girl sparks outrage in Kashmir, one arrested - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **J&K Police** arrested a local youth in connection with the alleged rape and murder of a 12-year-old girl in Budgam, central Kashmir. The victim's body was discovered several meters from her home on Sunday (May 24, 2026), along with a copy of the Quran and her shoes.  The incident sparked outrage, leading to calls for swift action from regional leaders and civil society groups. **Peoples Democratic Party** leader Iltija Mufti and **National Conference** leader Aga Syed Ruhullah expressed grief and demanded accountability. **J&K Chief Minister Omar Abdulla** condemned the murder and pledged government support for a thorough investigation.

recent_articles.title: What’s inside the Kaaba and what covers it? The story of the Kiswah | Religion News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Kaaba, Islam's holiest site, is draped in a black silk cloth called the Kiswah. The Kiswah is embroidered with gold and silver thread and features verses from the Quran.  The tradition of covering the Kaaba began before Islam, with its origins possibly linked to pre-Islamic Arabian tribes.  The current Kiswah weighs approximately 670kg and costs more than $6.65 million to produce. The Kiswah is replaced annually by a specialized team of workers who carefully preserve valuable sections for museums or institutions.
